articles.title: Cortex Framework v7 is GA: Build agentic workflows without disrupting SAP operations
articles.summary: Google announces the general availability of Cortex Framework v7, enabling businesses to deploy AI agents without disrupting mission-critical ERP systems.
articles.detail: The framework provides interoperable data products that act as a single, reusable source of truth, turning cryptic source system records into clear business terms.

articles.title: Behind the scenes: How we build, test, and scale Google Agent Skills
articles.summary: Google shares insights into building, testing, and scaling Google Agent Skills, encoding domain knowledge into structured instructions.
articles.detail: The goal is to make AI coding agents smarter, safer, and more accurate.

articles.title: Automate data monitoring and root-cause analysis with Looker Agentic Workflows
articles.summary: Google introduces Looker Agentic Workflows in preview, automating metric monitoring and root-cause analysis using intelligent background agents.
articles.detail: The capability extends Conversational Analytics in Looker, enabling teams to explore insights without manual hunting through dashboards.

articles.title: Automate your agent development lifecycle using any coding agent
articles.summary: Google provides a practical walkthrough on building real-world agents using Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
articles.detail: The platform enables unified embeddings that connect users' inferred interests with the breadth of what advertisers offer in their deep funnel ads.

articles.title: What's new in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
articles.summary: Google updates Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform with new features and enhancements.
articles.detail: The innovations aim to strengthen AI cybersecurity as the annual Black Hat conference begins in Las Vegas.

articles.title: AWS Weekly Roundup: Price reduction of GPT models in Bedrock, CloudWatch managed collectors for Prometheus metrics, and more (August 3, 2026)
articles.summary: AWS announces a price reduction of GPT models in Bedrock and introduces CloudWatch managed collectors for Prometheus metrics.
articles.detail: The updates aim to enhance AI capabilities on the AWS cloud platform.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Immutability to the most recent seven days of backups on Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance
articles.summary: Azure announces the general availability of immutability for the most recent seven days of backups on Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance.
articles.detail: The capability enhances backup protection by automatically applying immutability to the most recent seven days of backups.

articles.title: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for late-July
articles.summary: Azure introduces a new update and enhancement to Azure SQL in late-July 2026.
articles.detail: The update includes regex-based dynamic data masking (DDM) extending the built-in DDM feature with pattern-based masking to hide sensitive data.

articles.title: Exploring Hierarchical Interest Representation For Meta Ads Deep Funnel Optimization
articles.summary: Meta explores hierarchical interest representation to connect users' inferred interests with the breadth of what advertisers offer in their deep funnel ads.
articles.detail: The innovations aim to strengthen AI cybersecurity as the annual Black Hat conference begins in Las Vegas.

articles.title: Wireless isn't magic—it's just better when you stop micromanaging your network
articles.summary: Cisco shares a story about Room & Board ditching cables and embracing AI for network management.
articles.detail: The company found peace by letting their network manage itself.

articles.title: KIOXIA's new GP1 Series PCIe 6.0 SSDs unlock 10 million random read IOPS
articles.summary: KIOXIA announces its new GP1 Series PCIe 6.0 NVMe SSDs with impressive performance.
articles.detail: The drives deliver an impressive 10 million random read IOPS performance.

articles.title: Morgan Stanley forecasts cloud spending to reach $1.2T by 2027, and crypto miners are paying attention
articles.summary: Morgan Stanley predicts significant growth in cloud spending, with crypto miners taking notice.
articles.detail: The surge in cloud spending could reshape tech industries and alter investment strategies globally.

articles.title: CXMT Eyes Second Beijing Memory Fab After Record IPO, Circling the Gap Samsung and Micron Left Behind
articles.summary: CXMT considers building a second memory chip plant in Beijing after its record-setting IPO.
articles.detail: The company is regularly discussed as a Chinese chip firm that might be able to compete on the global stage due to the ongoing turmoil between major players.

articles.title: To power AI, Khosla and a16z bet this startup can reinvent mining
articles.summary: Mariana Minerals is valued at $1.5 billion after securing funding from investors including Khosla and a16z.
articles.detail: The startup aims to revolutionize the mining industry with AI-powered technology.
